provisions.title: Implementation
provisions.body:
The document has been created and approved by the General Assembly of 09.11.2024.
The document and its rules have been implemented since the 2025 season beside the part in Blue.

Competitors will have a grace period to align their equipment with the rule written in Blue. This grace period will end on 31/12/2027.

provisions.title: Definition
provisions.body:
Wolf Ribs helmets are bascinet-based helmets topped by a central-pivot facial grill. The few available sources are paintings from the Czech Republic and Germany. The primary sources are dated from 1380 and 1450.

The helmet is very similar to other bascinets. It is constructed with a center-hinge visor (such as Klappvisor), locked with a “spoon”, and is worn with an aventail.

Wolf Ribs helmets are Approved for 14th century and Transitional armors.
Wolf Ribs helmets with bascinet shape are Denied for 15th century armors.

provisions.title: General Requirements
provisions.body:
Reproductions must closely resemble the appearance and proportions of the sources.

Any metal part of the helmet must conform to the “Armors and Weapons Aesthetics and Decorations” document.

Any textile or leather part of the helmet must conform to the “Textiles and Leather” document.

provisions.title: Visor
provisions.body:
The visor must not be too long or too short and respect the proportions of historical sources.

The hinge must be reproduced as per historical sources.

It is permitted to weld the hinge. Welded hinges must resemble a functional hinge.

It is permitted to weld the visor down. A welded visor must resemble a functional removable visor.

It is permitted to add a metal plate to protect the throat. Such a plate must be strong enough to endure full contact fight and must be concealed under the aventail.

The visor must consist of 5 horizontal ribs.
Ribs must be round or bar-shaped.
Ribs can not be made of flat sheets.

provisions.title: Eye slots
provisions.body:
It is not recommended to have oversized eye slots (over 30x50 mm).
It is permitted to add up to four (4) vertical safety Eye bars on the visor: two (2) on each side of the visor.
Eye bars must conform to the “Eye bars” document.

provisions.title: Aventail
provisions.body:
Wolf Ribs helmets must be worn with chainmail Aventails, fabric Aventails, or scales Aventails.
Aventails must conform to the “Aventails” document.
Chainmail Aventail must be fastened down to the edge of a padded pelerine, attached to the helmet liner.

Scales and fabric Aventails are recommended to be fastened down to the edge of a padded pelerine, attached to the helmet liner.

Any additional protective plates covering the cervical spine should be hidden under the Aventail.

provisions.title: Others
provisions.body:
Wolf Ribs helmets may be decorated in the spirit of medieval styles, such as an orle, torse, decorated aventails (with copper/brass chainmail rings), vervelle covers, coat of arms badges, etc.

Such decoration must be made in coherence with historical sources.
Using modern and/or offensive imagery and slogans is prohibited.

provisions.title: Changelog
provisions.body:
Below, we will keep track of all the changes made over the lifetime of this document. This way, all our members can see how the documents are changing over time.

January - 2026 (V. 26.1) Formatting redone for consistency and readability. Except points listed below, no content changes

Add: “1. Implementation” (and subsequent modification of all Title numbers in the document) Format: Following sentences in Blue for Implementation schedule:
- In 2. Definition: “Wolf Ribs helmets with bascinet shape are denied for 15th century armor.” Replace:
- In 4.4 Aventails:
- “The aventail must be fastened down to the outer edge of a padded pelerine attached to the helmet liner.” by “Chainmail aventail must be fastened down to the edge of a padded pelerine, attached to the helmet liner.”
- “Wolf Ribs helmets can be worn with chainmail or fabric Aventails. Scales aventails are not permitted.” by “Wolf Ribs helmets must be worn with chainmail Aventails, fabric Aventails, or scales Aventails.”
- “Protective plates covering the cervical spine should be hidden under the Aventail.” by “Any additional protective plates covering the cervical spine should be hidden under the Aventail.” Add:
- In 4.4 Aventails: “Scales and Fabric aventails are recommended to be fastened down to the edge of a padded pelerine, attached to the helmet liner.”

March - 2025 (V2025.03)
- Clarification: Wolf Ribs helmets with bascinet shape are denied for 15th century armors

February - 2025 (V2025.02)
